title: Two headsets fighting

complaints.says: My headset sounds garbled, and I can hear the associate pastor in it.
And mine's not in the room at all.

win.label: Pastor clear in the mains
win.hint: The WL2 body-pack is on WL1's frequency (518.200). Set it to 524.600 to match the WL2 receiver.

hints: Compare the frequency on each body-pack with the receiver it's meant to talk to.
cause: The WL2 body-pack had been set to WL1's frequency, so both packs were talking to the WL1 receiver and WL2's receiver heard nothing.
lesson: Each transmitter needs its own frequency, matched to its own receiver. Two packs on one frequency interfere with each other.
